Team —

Quick reminder: finance needs cleaned stage and commit signals for the March forecast. I want a short red/yellow/green list for your top 12 at-commit deals by EOD Tuesday (today) so FP&A can finalize revisions. For any red deals, include a one-paragraph save-plan with owner, exec ask, checkpoints, and the immediate next action.

Attached a simple sheet and a save-plan template — please populate and keep each save-plan to one page. Primary asks:
- Update stage to reflect realistic probability (not optimistic close hope)
- Mark commit status (commit / best-case / upside)
- Add expected procurement/PO date if known

Heads-up: I may escalate 2–3 red deals to leadership for decisioning (credits, discounts, or alternative routing). If you need pre-approval for discounts >20% or credit allowances, flag here and include required approver.

Send your lists to me and CC Monica (finance ops) by EOD. I will consolidate and share with FP&A.

Attachments: [attachment: pipeline_risk_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)], [attachment: save_plan_template.docx (docx, 12KB)]

Marissa will own the customer comms and will send the revised amendment draft. Monica — can you please run a quick exposure check on the 10% credit (ballpark) and confirm who needs to sign credit approvals?

Sarah — can you confirm whether legal can review the one-page amendment by Thursday morning? If yes, I'll ask our contracts team to prioritize.

Thanks all — we want to avoid having Acme slide from commit to best-case in the forecast.
